findings.detail: The four new library string resources (library_sort_az, library_sort_za, library_edit_pinned, library_check_button) were added to both values/strings.xml and values-th/strings.xml but are never referenced. The code renders hardcoded English literals instead: "A–Z ▼"/"Z–A ▲" (allCategoriesHeader, ~line 573), "Edit" (pinnedHeader, ~line 598), "↻ Check" (checkSummaryRow, ~line 851), plus untranslated AlertDialog literals "Pinned categories" (~line 618) and "Done" (~line 625). The plan and FEAT-002 explicitly specified adding AND using these resources so Thai users get the translated labels. Replace the literals with getString(R.string.library_sort_az/library_sort_za/library_edit_pinned/library_check_button); consider adding/using string resources for the dialog title and button too. Non-blocking localization gap — the fixes are functionally correct and the build is green.
